question: Who was honoured with the Luminous Lummer Dai Literary Award in 2025 for their contributions to Assamese literature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ramchandra Chutia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Luminous Lummer Dai Literary Award:** This award is named after **Lummer Dai**, a renowned literary figure who made significant contributions to Assamese literature and culture.
 
• The award recognizes individuals who have made exceptional contributions to the enrichment of Assamese literature, promoting its growth and preserving its cultural heritage.
 
• **Ramchandra Chutia:** He was honored with the award in **2025** for his outstanding contributions to Assamese literature, showcasing his mastery in storytelling and poetry that resonates deeply with the Assamese community.
 
• Ramchandra Chutia is widely regarded as a literary figure whose works reflect the essence of Assamese language, culture, and traditions.
 
• His writings are celebrated for their depth, emotional appeal, and ability to address key societal issues, making him a deserving recipient of this prestigious award.
 
• The other options, such as **Nirupama Borgohain** and **Indira Goswami**, are also renowned Assamese literary figures but were not the recipients of the Luminous Lummer Dai Literary Award in **2025**.
 
• *Hence, the correct answer is Ramchandra Chutia.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Lummer Dai:**

 
 
• **Lummer Dai** was a celebrated Assamese author and journalist known for his contributions to literature, particularly focusing on the socio-cultural aspects of Assam.
 
• His works have inspired several generations of writers and cultural enthusiasts in Assam, making him a pivotal figure in Assamese literature.
 
 
 
• **Other Renowned Assamese Literary Figures:**
 
 
• **Nirupama Borgohain:** A prominent Assamese writer and journalist known for her novels and short stories that explore societal issues, especially pertaining to women's rights.
 
• **Indira Goswami:** Also known as Mamoni Raisom Goswami, she is one of the most celebrated literary figures in Assam. Her works often delve into the complexities of human emotions and societal challenges.
 
• **Homen Borgohain:** A respected writer and journalist, he has contributed significantly to Assamese literature through his novels, essays, and journalistic works.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Luminous Lummer Dai Literary Award:**
 
 
• The award serves to honor individuals who have showcased exemplary contributions to Assamese literature and culture, ensuring its preservation and growth.
 
• It aims to inspire future generations to engage with and contribute to the rich literary tradition of Assam.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Assamese Literature:**

 
 
• **Assamese literature** has a rich history, rooted in ancient traditions and characterized by its unique blend of poetry, prose, and drama.
 
• The language has produced numerous literary giants who have contributed to its growth and global recognition.
 
 
 
• **Role of Literary Awards:**
 
 
• Literary awards play a crucial role in recognizing and encouraging writers to continue their work, thereby enriching the cultural and literary landscape of a region.
 
• They also bring attention to lesser-known writers and help preserve the literary heritage of a language or culture.
